nodes.title: IAM / Profiles ownership
nodes.body:
[Logical SQL schema groups: MySQL]
users; company_profiles. Identity/profile references by user_id.

nodes.title: Inventory ownership
nodes.body:
[Logical SQL schema group: MySQL]
equipment_categories, equipments, availability_blocks. Own equipment data and period commitments.

nodes.title: Rentals ownership
nodes.body:
[Logical SQL schema group: MySQL]
rental_requests, rentals, deliveries, equipment_returns. Confirmed and active rental lifecycle.

nodes.title: Maintenance / Subscriptions ownership
nodes.body:
[Logical SQL schema groups: MySQL]
incidents, maintenances; subscription_plans, user_subscriptions. Separate owners.
